title: Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Acceptability Criteria by Tier
content:
The Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy is offered at each tier only to households that meet the criteria below.

| Criterion | 1M | 2M | 3M | 4M | 5M | 10M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary residence insured on a live Larkspur homeowners, condominium or renters policy | Required | Required | Required | Required | Required | Required |
| Liability claims paid by any carrier in the lookback at which the umbrella is not offered or renewed | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Lookback for the liability claims count (years) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Most major driving violations in the last 3 years | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Youngest age of the named insured | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 |

## How the liability claims count is taken

The count is the number of liability claims paid for the household by any carrier in the 5 years ending on the evaluation date. The evaluation date is the bind date, or, at renewal, the renewal offer date. The claims counted are those disclosed on the application and those on Larkspur claim records: liability claim entries on the household's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, RentGuard Renters Policy and LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy claim files, and umbrella claim payments. Each claim is counted once, however many records or payments show it.

At a count of 2 the umbrella is not offered or renewed on any tier. A count of 0 or 1 is below that figure.

## Reading the criteria

- The residence criterion is the same on all six tiers: a live Larkspur homeowners, condominium or renters policy on the primary residence.
- Major driving violations: Larkspur Umbrella 1M, 2M and 3M accept a household with at most one major violation in the last 3 years; Larkspur Umbrella 4M, 5M and 10M accept none.
- The named insured is at least 21 years old on every tier. *Hypothetical:* a named insured aged 21 meets it; one aged 20 does not.
